title: Theta functions of the CM curve: periods and scales, tight frames, the integral vacuum, Galois conjugates of jets, and divisibility of jets at non-split primes
summary: The folder New/Curve. It fixes a CM elliptic curve 𝓔 = ℂ/Ω₀𝓞_K for K = ℚ(√−d) and the scales s₀, s₁ and per at which Taylor series of theta functions are taken; builds tight frames (substitutes for orthonormal bases) of every large length in E = K(ζ_{N₁}); shows that the scaled vacuum κ₀ⁿ·vac of a standard hermitian space has p-adically integral values with bounded archimedean conjugates; and describes how Aut(ℂ/K) acts on the jets (Taylor coefficients) of theta functions. At primes p inert or ramified in K it proves a normal form of theta series (an integral series times one exponential), the resulting lower bound for the p-adic valuation of Schur jets (divisibility, `norm_schurJet_le`) and its sharpness (`exists_hasLargeSplit_of_pairs`, `CMLattice.katz_divisibility_limit`), and it defines the asked divisibility (`Data.localAsk`, `Data.gain`), the allowed loss and the column counts κ used by the chain of theta lifts.
